In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
The President of the Republic
[signature: 27/08/2026]

To the Speaker of the People's Majlis, Honourable Abdul Raheem Abdulla,

After respectful greetings, I write as follows.

As the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation has become vacant, and following a public announcement for the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation in accordance with Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), I am sending with this letter the names and information of the persons I consider suitable from among those who responded.

1. Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo

2. Mr. Ahmed Maosoom / V. Mi'aress

3. Ms. Mariyam Jaida, Kandugasdhoshuge / K. Dhiffushi

Therefore, I request that the above names be submitted to the People's Majlis, and that, in whatever manner the Majlis sees fit, the Majlis approve the name of a person for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation and inform me accordingly.

Please accept my respects.

13 Rabi' al-Awwal 1448
26 August 2026

Your servant
[signature]
Mohamed Muizzu

People's Majlis
Malé,
Republic of Maldives.
